implementation.name: original-v4-05-compounding-error-flywheel
implementation.scope: Original learner/plant loop and one schematic takeover. The five-second lookback is retained; the curve is conceptual, not a measured error trace.
implementation.question: Which takeover data can become expert labels?

purpose: Separate observations useful for relabeling from commands that must remain masked around takeover.
guard: Mask commands from drift through blend and reorientation. Relabel-eligible states are not expert actions. Curve shape does not quantify a learning guarantee.
